title: jachʼa jachʼa tukuñ manqhan chhaqtkäna uka tesoro
intro: Wali jachʼa qamir pilanak nayraqatan saytʼatäkasmas ukham amuytʼañäni, llavenak aptʼasiñakix mä tama chʼamani jaqinakaruw qarjaspa. Juman jakʼamanjja, altʼat chuymanïñataki ukat amtasiñatakiw arunakajj chʼamañchi, ukampis jachʼa jachʼa tukuñajj yuspärañat sipansa jukʼamp jachʼawa. ¿Kunas pasaspa kunapachatï jachʼa jachʼa tukuñajj mä yantʼar tukuwayjje ukat jachʼa jachʼa tukuñajj kunjamsa lurasini uk sellaraki?
clues: Nayajj Musa jaqenak taypit jaqëyätwa, ukampis jupanak contraw juchañchayäta.
Nayarojj wali jachʼa tesoronakwa churapjjetäna, uka tesoronakan llavenakapajj mä tama chʼamani jaqenakaruw qʼepir tukuyirïna.
Nayarux markajan iwxt’apxituwa, jan kusisiñataki, ukat akapachan qullqij jan armasisa, Akhira pacha thaqhañataki.
Kunatï utjkitu ukajj yatiñanïtaj laykuw churasi sasaw sista.
Nayajj markajan nayraqatapanwa kʼachachtʼat desfilayäta, ukat akapachan jakañ munirinakajj kuntï nayajj utjkitu ukar uñtasitäñwa munapjjäna.
Uraqix jakañamp chikaw manq’antawayitu, janiw khitis yanapt’kituti, janirakiw naya pachpas yanapt’irjamäkti.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
